name: atlas-luna-agent-effect-v1
description: Human-authored Atlas-only paired agent benchmark. Baseline receives native repository tools; treatment receives the same tools plus Atlas MCP.

tasks.title: Initialize a maintained repository
tasks.prompt: Explain when a maintainer should run atlas init and which repository-local Atlas files it prepares.

criteria.description: Answers both when to run init and what it prepares.
Identifies atlas init as the setup command.
Uses repository-relative evidence citations.
Makes no unsupported repository-behavior claims.

tasks.title: Import an artifact without cloning
tasks.prompt: Explain what atlas repo add org/repo does for a consumer who wants repository documentation without cloning the full source repository.

criteria.description: Explains the consumer import workflow and its no-full-clone purpose.
Identifies atlas repo add as the relevant command.
Uses repository-relative evidence citations.
Does not claim that Atlas fetches source at query time.

tasks.title: Verify an artifact safely
tasks.prompt: What does Atlas artifact verification check regarding manifest validity, checksums, importability, and secret or machine-path safety?

criteria.description: Addresses the requested verification areas.
Correctly describes manifest/checksum/importability and safety checks.
Uses repository-relative evidence citations.
Does not expose credentials or absolute machine paths.

tasks.title: Recover from a stale artifact
tasks.prompt: A maintained Atlas artifact is stale. State the documented recovery guidance and what should be committed afterward.

criteria.description: Gives a concrete stale-artifact recovery path.
Includes the documented build-and-commit guidance.
Uses repository-relative evidence citations.
Does not invent an automatic stale-artifact repair mechanism.

tasks.title: Protect the public artifact boundary
tasks.prompt: Explain which material public Atlas artifacts must exclude and why that boundary matters.

criteria.description: Explains the public-profile exclusion boundary and purpose.
Mentions internal/private material and sensitive machine or credential data as excluded.
Uses repository-relative evidence citations.
Does not reproduce credential-like values or local paths.

tasks.title: Explain local-first query behavior
tasks.prompt: At query time, do Atlas search, retrieval, MCP, or HTTP reads fetch remote source content or upload the indexed corpus? Explain the boundary.

criteria.description: Answers both remote-fetch and upload aspects.
Correctly states the query-time local-first boundary.
Uses repository-relative evidence citations.
Does not overstate guarantees beyond the documented scope.

tasks.title: Keep credentials out of diagnostic output
tasks.prompt: How should Atlas credentials and secret references be handled in config, logs, diagnostics, OpenAPI examples, MCP output, and snapshots?

criteria.description: Addresses secret references and output/storage boundaries.
States that secrets are referenced by environment variable name rather than written into outputs.
Uses repository-relative evidence citations.
Does not include token-like strings or private URLs.

tasks.title: Plan grounded context for an agent
tasks.prompt: Explain Atlas plan_context for a local-first agent: token budgets, selected evidence, and provenance.

criteria.description: Explains planning, token budget, evidence, and provenance.
Correctly describes plan_context as a local retrieval/context-planning surface.
Uses repository-relative evidence citations.
Does not claim remote query-time retrieval.

tasks.title: Use Atlas MCP over stdio
tasks.prompt: Summarize the documented Atlas server and MCP usage, including the stdio command and the HTTP MCP route.

criteria.description: Covers both stdio and HTTP MCP usage.
Names the documented Atlas MCP command and route accurately.
Uses repository-relative evidence citations.
Does not claim unsupported transport behavior.

tasks.title: Locate the CLI execution model
tasks.prompt: In the CLI App Execution Model, explain how runCli dispatches commands and returns structured results.

criteria.description: Explains command dispatch and structured result behavior.
Accurately identifies runCli and the CLI execution-model contract.
Uses repository-relative evidence citations.
Avoids inventing implementation details not documented by the section.

tasks.title: Explain retrieval omission diagnostics
tasks.prompt: Where and how does Atlas document retrieval omission diagnostics such as budget, authority, freshness, archive, and redundancy?

criteria.description: Explains the relevant omission diagnostics.
Correctly identifies the documented diagnostic concepts.
Uses repository-relative evidence citations.
Does not present omissions as arbitrary model behavior.

tasks.title: Abstain on an unknown Atlas concept
tasks.prompt: A user asks about zzzzqvx-no-such-atlas-concept-918273645. Respond safely and explain what you can and cannot verify from this repository.

criteria.description: Responds helpfully without fabricating a feature.
Clearly abstains from asserting that the unknown concept exists.
Does not invent commands, configuration, or documentation for the concept.
Does not expose local environment details while explaining the limitation.
